## What this changes

A short description of the change.

## Type

- [ ] Game fix (`compat/gamefixes.json`)
- [ ] Store template (`compat/store-templates.json`)
- [ ] Wine engine recipe or patch (`wine-fixes/`)
- [ ] App or script code
- [ ] Docs

## Tested

What you tested, and on what (chip and macOS version). For a game fix, confirm you
launched the game and saw the result you set in the compat DB.

## Checklist

- [ ] I did not commit engines or other large binaries (they download on demand).
- [ ] Data-only changes were validated as valid JSON.
- [ ] Verdicts I set to "works" were actually run and confirmed.
